arrows-sting-talisman.name: Arrow's Sting Talisman
arrows-sting-talisman.description: A talisman depicting three iron arrows. Carried by soldiers long ago.
arrows-sting-talisman.effectText: Raises attack power of arrows and bolts

arsenal-charm.name: Arsenal Charm
arsenal-charm.description: An iron charm that resembles a mass of weaponry. Boosts maximum equipment load. This talisman was derived from an unusual greatsword, once wielded by a hero hungry for vengeance.

assassins-cerulean-dagger.name: Assassin's Cerulean Dagger
assassins-cerulean-dagger.description: An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in cerulean. Critical hits restore FP.

assassins-crimson-dagger.name: Assassin's Crimson Dagger
assassins-crimson-dagger.description: An assassin's dagger, misshapen and stained in crimson. Critical hits restore HP.

arrows-reach-talisman.name: Arrow's Reach Talisman
arrows-reach-talisman.description: A talisman depicting three arrows. Carried by hunters of beasts.

axe-talisman.name: Axe Talisman
axe-talisman.description: A talisman depicting an axe and a warrior. Enhances charge attacks.

boltdrake-talisman.name: Boltdrake Talisman
boltdrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a yellow ancient dragon. Boosts lightning damage negation.

blue-dancer-charm.name: Blue Dancer Charm
blue-dancer-charm.description: A cloth doll depicting a dancer garbed in blue. An ancient heirloom of some sort.
blue-dancer-charm.effectText: Raises attack power with lower equipment load

blessed-dew-talisman.name: Blessed Dew Talisman
blessed-dew-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a drop of the Erdtree's sap, a blessed boon.

bull-goats-talisman.name: Bull-goat's Talisman
bull-goats-talisman.description: A talisman depicting the horns of a bull-goat. Raises poise.

cerulean-amber-medallion.name: Cerulean Amber Medallion
cerulean-amber-medallion.description: A medallion with cerulean amber inlaid. Boosts maximum FP.

carian-filigreed-crest.name: Carian Filigreed Crest
carian-filigreed-crest.description: A talisman adorned with the royal crest.

cerulean-seed-talisman.name: Cerulean Seed Talisman
cerulean-seed-talisman.description: A cerulean-colored talisman patterned after an Erdtree seed. Boosts FP restoration from the Flask of Cerulean Tears.
cerulean-seed-talisman.effectText: Boosts FP restoration from Flask of Cerulean Tears

clarifying-horn-charm.name: Clarifying Horn Charm
clarifying-horn-charm.description: An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers. Raises focus. (Focus governs resistance to sleep and madness.)

claw-talisman.name: Claw Talisman
claw-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a claw and an assassin. Enhances jump attacks.

crucible-knot-talisman.name: Crucible Knot Talisman
crucible-knot-talisman.description: A talisman fashioned from a bony knot that embodies that aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.
crucible-knot-talisman.effectText: Reduces damage and impact of headshots

crimson-amber-medallion.name: Crimson Amber Medallion
crimson-amber-medallion.description: A medallion with Crimson amber inlaid. Boosts maximum HP. The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. A primordial life energy resides inside

crucible-scale-talisman.name: Crucible Scale Talisman
crucible-scale-talisman.description: A talisman fashioned from a scale that embodies the aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.
crucible-scale-talisman.effectText: Reduces damage taken from critical hits

crepuss-vial.name: Crepus's Vial
crepuss-vial.description: Small mysterious bottle with a dark mist sealed within.
crepuss-vial.effectText: Eliminates all sound made by the wearer during movement

curved-sword-talisman.name: Curved Sword Talisman
curved-sword-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a curved sword and a swordsman. Enhances guard counters.

dragoncrest-shield-talisman.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
dragoncrest-shield-talisman.description: Wrought iron talisman depicting a trio of ancient dragons. Boosts physical damage negation.

flamedrake-talisman.name: Flamedrake Talisman
flamedrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a red ancient dragon. Boosts fire damage negation.

fire-scorpion-charm.name: Fire Scorpion Charm
fire-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that burns with fire.
fire-scorpion-charm.effectText: Raises fire attack, but lowers damage negation

godskin-swaddling-cloth.name: Godskin Swaddling Cloth
godskin-swaddling-cloth.description: Sacred cloth of the Godskin Apostles, made from supple skin sewn together.

faithfuls-canvas-talisman.name: Faithful's Canvas Talisman
faithfuls-canvas-talisman.description: A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a group of masked figures. Raises potency of incantations.

great-jars-arsenal.name: Great-jar's Arsenal
great-jars-arsenal.description: A charm that resembles a great jar overflowing with weaponry. Vastly boosts maximum equipment load.

haligdrake-talisman.name: Haligdrake Talisman
haligdrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a golden ancient dragon. Boosts holy damage negation.

green-turtle-talisman.name: Green Turtle Talisman
green-turtle-talisman.description: A talisman in the shape of a green turtle. Raises stamina recovery speed.

hammer-talisman.name: Hammer Talisman
hammer-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a hammer and a knight. Enhances stamina-reducing attacks against a blocking opponent.

immunizing-horn-charm.name: Immunizing Horn Charm
immunizing-horn-charm.description: An accountrement worn by the ancestral followers. Raises immunity. (Immunity governs resistance to poison and rot.)

kindred-of-rots-exultation.name: Kindred Of Rot's Exultation
kindred-of-rots-exultation.description: A talisman depicting the exultation of pests.
kindred-of-rots-exultation.effectText: Poisoning or rot in vicinity increases attack power

lightning-scorpion-charm.name: Lightning Scorpion Charm
lightning-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that sparks with lightning.
lightning-scorpion-charm.effectText: Raises lightning attack, but lowers damage negation

longtail-cat-talisman.name: Longtail Cat Talisman
longtail-cat-talisman.description: A brooch depicting Lacrima, the long-tailed cat.
longtail-cat-talisman.effectText: Renders the wearer immune to fall damage

marikas-scarseal.name: Marika's Scarseal
marikas-scarseal.description: An eye engraved with an Elden Rune. Said to be the seal of Queen Marika.
marikas-scarseal.effectText: Raises attributes, but also increases damage taken

lord-of-bloods-exultation.name: Lord Of Blood's Exultation
lord-of-bloods-exultation.description: A talisman depicting the exultation of the Lord of Blood.

mottled-necklace.name: Mottled Necklace
mottled-necklace.description: A vividly-colored accoutrement precious to the ancestral followers.

moon-of-nokstella.name: Moon Of Nokstella
moon-of-nokstella.description: This legendary talisman is a treasure of Nokstella, the Eternal City.

old-lords-talisman.name: Old Lord's Talisman
old-lords-talisman.description: A legendary talisman depicting the ancient king whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond time.

pearldrake-talisman.name: Pearldrake Talisman
pearldrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a pearlescent ancient dragon. Boosts non-physical damage negation.

primal-glintstone-blade.name: Primal Glintstone Blade
primal-glintstone-blade.description: An old glintstone blade that has been stained with blood.
primal-glintstone-blade.effectText: Spells consume less FP, but maximum HP is reduced

prince-of-deaths-pustule.name: Prince Of Death's Pustule
prince-of-deaths-pustule.description: A fetid pustule taken from facial flesh. Raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)

radagon-icon.name: Radagon Icon
radagon-icon.description: A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Radagon. Shortens the casting time of sorceries and incantations.

radagons-scarseal.name: Radagon's Scarseal
radagons-scarseal.description: An eye engraved with an Elden Rune. Said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.
radagons-scarseal.effectText: Raises attributes, but also increases damage taken.

radagons-soreseal.name: Radagon's Soreseal
radagons-soreseal.description: This legendary talisman is an eye engraved with an Elden Rune, said to be the seal of King Consort Radagon.
radagons-soreseal.effectText: Greatly raises attributes, but also increases damage taken

sacred-scorpion-charm.name: Sacred Scorpion Charm
sacred-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart with a blessed glow.
sacred-scorpion-charm.effectText: Raises holy attack, but lowers damage negation.

sacrificial-twig.name: Sacrificial Twig
sacrificial-twig.description: A talisman fashioned from a dried twig, so slender that it might snap at the slightest touch.
sacrificial-twig.effectText: Will be lost on death in place of runes.

shabriris-woe.name: Shabriri's Woe
shabriris-woe.description: Disturbing likeness of a man whose eyes have been gouged out. The corners of his mouth are upturned in an almost flirtatious manner.

spelldrake-talisman.name: Spelldrake Talisman
spelldrake-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a blue ancient dragon. Boosts magic damage negation.

stargazer-heirloom.name: Stargazer Heirloom
stargazer-heirloom.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of a queen. Raises intelligence.

twinblade-talisman.name: Twinblade Talisman
twinblade-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a twinblade and a confessor. Enhances the final hit ending a chain of attacks.
twinblade-talisman.effectText: Enhances final hit of chain attacks.

takers-cameo.name: Taker's Cameo
takers-cameo.description: A talisman engraved with a stern likeness of Praetor Rykard, master of Volcano Manor.

starscourge-heirloom.name: Starscourge Heirloom
starscourge-heirloom.description: A talisman engraved with a scene from a heroic tale. Raises strength.

viridian-amber-medallion.name: Viridian Amber Medallion
viridian-amber-medallion.description: A medallion with viridian amber inlaid. Boosts maximum stamina. The Erdtree's old sap becomes amber, treasured as the most precious of jewels in the age of Godfrey, the first Elden Lord. A primordial life energy resides inside

two-fingers-heirloom.name: Two Fingers Heirloom
two-fingers-heirloom.description: A talisman engraved with the legend of the Two Fingers. Raises faith.

winged-sword-insignia.name: Winged Sword Insignia
winged-sword-insignia.description: A talisman depicting a raised prosthetic blade. An honor bestowed upon the knights who fought alongside Malenia the Severed.
winged-sword-insignia.effectText: Raises attack power with successive attacks

erdtrees-favor.name: Erdtree's Favor
erdtrees-favor.description: A talisman depicting a special blessing of the Erdtree. Slightly raises maximum HP, stamina, and equip load.
erdtrees-favor.effectText: Raises maximum HP, stamina and equip load

crimson-seed-talisman.name: Crimson Seed Talisman
crimson-seed-talisman.description: A crimson-colored talisman patterned after an Erdtree seed. Boosts HP restoration from the Flask of Crimson Tears.
crimson-seed-talisman.effectText: Boosts HP regeneration from Flask of Crimson Tears

graven-school-talisman.name: Graven-school Talisman
graven-school-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a school of graven mages, the nightmare of the academy.

godfrey-icon.name: Godfrey Icon
godfrey-icon.description: A legendary talisman depicting the Elden Lord Godfrey. Raises charge attack power of sorceries, incantations, and skills.

lance-talisman.name: Lance Talisman
lance-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a lance and a knight. Enhances attacks while on horseback.

graven-mass-talisman.name: Graven-mass Talisman
graven-mass-talisman.description: A talisman depicting the first school of graven mages — a nightmare that would continue to haunt the academy.  Greatly raises potency of sorceries.  The primeval current is a forbidden tradition of glintstone sorcery. To those who cleave to its teachings, the act of collecting sorcerers to fashion them into the seeds of stars is but another path of scientific inquiry.

ancestral-spirits-horn.name: Ancestral Spirit's Horn
ancestral-spirits-horn.description: Item cut from the horns of the Regal Ancestor Spirit.

stalwart-horn-charm.name: Stalwart Horn Charm
stalwart-horn-charm.description: An accoutrement worn by the ancestral followers. Greatly raises robustness. (Robustness governs resistance to blood loss and frost.)  Said to be a budding horn. The ancestral followers believe that the horns of a long-lived beast continue to bud like antlers, over and over again, until the beast one day becomes an ancestral spirit.

dragoncrest-greatshield-talisman.name: Dragoncrest Greatshield Talisman
dragoncrest-greatshield-talisman.description: Legendary talisman of wrought iron depicting a massive ancient dragon. Enormously boosts physical damage negation.

marikas-soreseal.name: Marika's Soreseal
marikas-soreseal.description: This legendary talisman is an eye engraved with an Elden Rune, said to be the seal of Queen Marika.
marikas-soreseal.effectText: Greatly raises attributes, but also increases damage taken.

gold-scarab.name: Gold Scarab
gold-scarab.description: A talisman facsimile of a scarab, the carrier of treasures and precious things.

ritual-sword-talisman.name: Ritual Sword Talisman
ritual-sword-talisman.description: A talisman patterned after swords used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.
ritual-sword-talisman.effectText: Raises attack power when HP is at maximum.

ritual-shield-talisman.name: Ritual Shield Talisman
ritual-shield-talisman.description: A talisman patterned after shields used in ritual combat held to honor the Erdtree.
ritual-shield-talisman.effectText: Raises defense when HP is at maximum.

perfumers-talisman.name: Perfumer's Talisman
perfumers-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a set of perfume bottles. Raises potency of perfume items.

blue-feathered-branchsword.name: Blue-feathered Branchsword
blue-feathered-branchsword.description: A talisman adorned with blue feathers, once used in ancient death rituals.
blue-feathered-branchsword.effectText: Raises defense when HP is low.

magic-scorpion-charm.name: Magic Scorpion Charm
magic-scorpion-charm.description: A talisman carried by assassins who strike unseen. Patterned on a scorpion freshly shed of its exoskeleton, its claws seizing a heart that shimmers with magic.
magic-scorpion-charm.effectText: Raises magic attack, but lowers damage negation

prince-of-deaths-cyst.name: Prince Of Death's Cyst
prince-of-deaths-cyst.description: A fetid, overgrown cyst taken from facial flesh. Greatly raises vitality. (Vitality governs resistance to the effects of Death.)

warrior-jar-shard.name: Warrior Jar Shard
warrior-jar-shard.description: Shard of a shattered warrior jar.
warrior-jar-shard.effectText: Boosts the attack power of skills.

shard-of-alexander.name: Shard Of Alexander
shard-of-alexander.description: Shard of the late Alexander, a shattered warrior jar.
shard-of-alexander.effectText: Greatly boosts the attack power of skills.

greatshield-talisman.name: Greatshield Talisman
greatshield-talisman.description: Talisman depicting a knight holding a greatshield. Boosts guarding ability.

millicents-prosthesis.name: Millicent's Prosthesis
millicents-prosthesis.description: Part of the golden prosthesis used by Millicent. The hand is locked into a fist that once raised a sword aloft.
millicents-prosthesis.effectText: Boosts dexterity, raises attack power with successive attacks

spear-talisman.name: Spear Talisman
spear-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a spear and a soldier. Enhances the counterattacks that are unique to thrusting weapons.
spear-talisman.effectText: Enhances counterattacks unique to thrusting weapons

dagger-talisman.name: Dagger Talisman
dagger-talisman.description: A talisman depicting a dagger and a surgeon. Enhances critical hits.

red-feathered-branchsword.name: Red-feathered Branchsword
red-feathered-branchsword.description: A talisman adorned with red feathers, once used in ancient death rituals.
red-feathered-branchsword.effectText: Raises attack power when HP is low.

companion-jar.name: Companion Jar
companion-jar.description: A talisman given by the jars to their friends. Raises potency of thrown jars.

flocks-canvas-talisman.name: Flock's Canvas Talisman
flocks-canvas-talisman.description: A talisman bearing an icon that depicts a mass of masked figures. Greatly raises potency of incantations.

concealing-veil.name: Concealing Veil
concealing-veil.description: Talisman put together from dark cloth with a lustrous sheen
concealing-veil.effectText: Conceals wearer while crouching away from foes

furled-fingers-trick-mirror.name: Furled Finger's Trick-mirror
furled-fingers-trick-mirror.description: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure. Makes the bearer take on the appearance of a Host of Fingers One of the ritual implements created by the Tarnished to deceive invaders.
furled-fingers-trick-mirror.effectText: Take on appearance of a Host of Fingers

crucible-feather-talisman.name: Crucible Feather Talisman
crucible-feather-talisman.description: A talisman fashioned from feathers that embody the aspects of various creatures. Said to have grown on the human body long ago.
crucible-feather-talisman.effectText: Improves dodge rolling but increases damage taken

daedicars-woe.name: Daedicar's Woe
daedicars-woe.description: Disturbing likeness of a woman whose skin was flayed. She smiles with a serene tenderness.

hosts-trick-mirror.name: Host's Trick-mirror
hosts-trick-mirror.description: A small, clouded mirror that reflects a flesh-and-blood figure.
hosts-trick-mirror.effectText: Take on appearance of a cooperator

entwining-umbilical-cord.name: Entwining Umbilical Cord
entwining-umbilical-cord.description: Mysterious circular object that's oddly warped. Changes the demeanour of the wearer's actions.
